# Calendar Integration Requirements Checklist: Calendar Context Ingestion

**Purpose**: Validate that calendar integration requirements are complete, clear, bounded, and ready for task generation.
**Created**: 2026-06-26
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are read-only calendar ingestion boundaries fully defined before any messaging, calendar-write, auto-join, auto-record, or retrospective matching behavior is allowed? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, Spec §FR-025, Spec §FR-026]
- [x] CHK002 Are all required calendar source states documented, including connection state, selected calendars, sync state, capability state, safe error state, and disconnect state? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, Spec §Key Entities]
- [x] CHK004 Are requirements defined for preserving unavailable or unsupported provider fields without fabricating titles, attendees, organizer data, or meeting links? [Completeness, Spec §User Story 2, Spec §FR-019]
- [x] CHK005 Are calendar event fields grouped clearly enough across identity, schedule, content, people/resources, provider versions, and limitation states? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005 through FR-008]
- [x] CHK006 Are future-recipient candidate requirements complete while excluding access grants, notifications, shares, and message sending? [Completeness, Spec §User Story 7, Spec §FR-010, Spec §FR-025]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK007 Is "the whole calendar" clarified as a rolling 12-month future horizon with no past events and no retrospective matching? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications, Spec §FR-022]
- [x] CHK008 Are "current", "upcoming", "selected future event", "ambiguous", "high confidence", and "no_calendar_context" defined clearly enough for recording-time context selection? [Clarity, Spec §User Story 3, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK009 Are title-source rules clear for calendar titles, safe fallback titles, workspace descriptive-name policy, and user-renamed meeting titles? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK010 Are join/open prompt and record prompt requirements clear about timing, required meeting-link presence, workspace policy, and the absence of automatic recording in 060? [Clarity, Spec §FR-023, Spec §SC-011]
- [x] CHK011 Are provider capability and limitation states described with user-visible meanings rather than hidden technical states? [Clarity, Spec §FR-019, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK012 Are "safe source snapshot" and "provider-specific extras that are safe to retain" bounded enough to avoid storing unrestricted sensitive payloads by default? [Ambiguity, Spec §User Story 2, Spec §FR-007]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK013 Are participant roster requirements consistent across calendar attendees, transcript speakers, meeting access, recipient candidates, and later speaker-mapping exclusions? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009, Spec §FR-010, Spec §User Story 4]
- [x] CHK014 Are disconnect requirements consistent between purging future/unmatched cache and retaining already matched meeting context under meeting retention/deletion policy? [Consistency, Spec §Clarifications, Spec §FR-018]
- [x] CHK015 Are prompt requirements consistent with constitution rules for visible capture state, manual start/stop, one-action Stop, and no hidden recording? [Consistency, Constitution §Visible Consent And User Control, Spec §FR-023, Spec §FR-026]
- [x] CHK016 Are provider-specific rich API requirements consistent with the provider-neutral normalized event model? [Consistency, Spec §Provider Research Summary, Spec §FR-004, Spec §Key Entities]
- [x] CHK017 Are failure-closed requirements consistent across stale sync, missing authorization, provider downtime, safe fallback titles, and meeting review availability? [Consistency, Spec §FR-021, Spec §SC-009]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK018 Can each provider coverage success criterion be objectively assessed without requiring live private calendar content or private screenshots in evidence? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002, Spec §SC-007]
- [x] CHK019 Can "100% of available fields are stored or marked unavailable/unsupported" be measured from fixture payloads without exposing private event text in evidence? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003, Spec §FR-017]
- [x] CHK020 Are acceptance criteria measurable for ambiguous event candidates, duplicate events, stale sync, cancelled events, and no-context fallback outcomes? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-005]
- [x] CHK021 Are no-egress acceptance criteria explicit enough to prove absence of emails, messages, share links, calendar updates, bot joins, hidden capture, auto-record, and retrospective matches? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-010]
- [x] CHK022 Are reminder acceptance criteria measurable for the one-minute join/open prompt and at-start record prompt while excluding automatic start behavior? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-011]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK023 Are primary flows covered for connecting a source, selecting calendars, syncing future events, linking a recording at start time, and showing calendar roster context? [Coverage, Spec §User Stories 1 through 4]
- [x] CHK024 Are alternate flows covered for multiple connected calendars, overlapping events, manual event selection, private/free-busy events, and recurring event instances? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK025 Are exception flows covered for expired credentials, revoked access, provider rate limits, malformed iCalendar, invalid timezones, deleted/cancelled events, and provider downtime? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-021]
- [x] CHK026 Are recovery requirements defined for reconnecting credentials, retrying failed sync, surfacing safe error reasons, and preserving meeting review when calendar context is unavailable? [Gap, Recovery, Spec §User Story 1, Spec §SC-009]
- [x] CHK027 Are later-layer exclusions covered as product scenarios so implementation tasks cannot accidentally include sending, sharing, calendar mutation, bot joins, auto-record, or past-recording matching? [Coverage, Spec §Assumptions, Spec §FR-025, Spec §FR-026]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK028 Are edge-case requirements complete for attachments metadata, passcodes, tracking URLs, stale links, multiple conference links, dial-in details, and sensitive agenda text? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-020]
- [x] CHK029 Are attendee edge cases addressed for groups, distribution lists, hidden attendees, declined attendees, no-response attendees, external guests, rooms/resources, duplicates, and missing email/display names? [Edge Case, Spec §User Story 4, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK030 Are recurrence edge cases defined for moved instances, cancelled instances, edited exceptions, duplicate UIDs, missing `DTEND`, floating times, and all-day events? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK031 Are policy-change edge cases defined for descriptive-title policy changes and external-recipient candidate policy changes after events were synced? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-012]
